questions.q: An infant has been diagnosed with Galactosemia. Which formula is appropriate for this infant?
questions.explain: Galactosemia is the inability to metabolize galactose (found in lactose). Breast milk and cow's milk contain lactose. Soy formula is galactose-free and safe.
